landing.subtitle: Keep your music collection and your own performances together. Save pieces, write notes, practise with your MIDI piano and keep your recordings.
landing.studioBody: Connect a MIDI device or try the on-screen piano labelled simulation. See and record the notes you play.
landing.card1Body: Keep the songs you like and the artists you follow in a single collection.
landing.card2Body: Rate in half-star steps and watch your taste take shape over time.
landing.card3Body: Write down what a song reminds you of and let your collection become a diary.
landing.sampleNote: "The drive back from Ankara, just before dawn. Writing it here so I do not forget."

library.emptyFollowsBody: Search for an artist and follow them; your discography coverage builds up here.
library.emptyPlaylistsBody: Create your first list and line your archived songs up inside it.

states.signedOutBody: This section shows your personal data. Sign in to continue.
states.searchUnavailable: Catalogue search is not configured right now. Your archive, the studio and your recordings keep working.
states.midiDeniedBody: Open the lock icon in the address bar, allow MIDI access in the site permissions, then reload the page. You can also play using the on-screen piano without granting permission.
states.insecureContext: Web MIDI only works over HTTPS or on localhost. Open this page from a secure address.
states.storageDenied: The browser recovery area could not be read. Check storage permissions — it may be disabled in a private window.
states.storageDeniedRecording: Recording did not start because the local recovery area could not be opened. Check storage permission and free space.

studio.title: Studio
studio.subtitle: Play. Watch the notes. Keep the take.
studio.connectHint: Connect your piano over USB/MIDI, then press Connect MIDI.
studio.connecting: Waiting for MIDI permission and device…
studio.connected: Device connected. You can play your piano.
studio.disconnected: No MIDI device found, or the connection dropped. It reconnects automatically when a device is plugged in.
studio.simulationOn: On-screen piano is active. This input is not a real MIDI device.
studio.keyboardLabel: 88-key piano. In simulation, play C4–C5 with A W S E D F T G Y H U J K.
studio.keyboardHint: A0–C8 • 88 keys. On small screens, scroll the keyboard sideways. Simulation: focus the piano and play with A–K.
studio.rollLabel: Piano roll of the last 8 seconds
studio.fullscreenFailed: Full screen could not be opened. Check your browser permissions.
studio.previewNote: The preview is synthesised. Sample-based piano sound is not implemented yet.
studio.previewFailed: Sound preview could not start. Check your browser's audio permission.
studio.captureNotice: MIDI events are not an audio recording. This version captures keys, timing, velocity and the sustain pedal. Microphone recording comes in a later phase.
studio.recording: Recording. A temporary copy is written to this browser every second.
studio.tagLimit: Use at most 12 tags, 40 characters each.
studio.piecesFailed: Pieces could not be loaded; you can still record freely.
studio.draftLocal: Recoverable in this browser • not uploaded yet.
studio.draftLost: Local storage failed. Download the .mid file before leaving this page.
studio.draftEmpty: No notes were played. You can start a new take.
studio.checkpointFailed: Local write failed. Download this take as .mid now.
studio.uploaded: Saved • on the server, private to your account.
studio.uploadFailedSuffix: You can also retry from Recordings using the local copy.
studio.newTakeNote: The previous local take can be recovered under Recordings.
studio.limits: Acceptance tests on real hardware — 30 minutes, hot-plug and a 10-note chord — are not complete yet. Recording limit: 60 minutes or 60,000 MIDI events.
studio.unsupported: This browser does not support Web MIDI. You can continue with the on-screen piano.

metronome.title: Metronome
metronome.tapHint: Tap at least four times, evenly.
metronome.note: The metronome plays only to your headphones; it is not part of the MIDI capture. Count-in time is excluded from the recording.
metronome.unavailable: The metronome could not start. Check your browser's audio permission.

recordings.deleteDraftConfirmBody: This draft exists only in this browser and was never uploaded. Deleting it cannot be undone.
recordings.noteEmpty: No notes on this recording yet.
